_about: Test proteins for the Structure tab. Every sequence was read from UniProt REST (https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/<accession>.json) on 2026-11-15. `uniprotLength` and `crc64` are UniProt's length and checksum of the whole entry sequence, so a person can check the entry has not changed. A `range` keeps only those residues (1-based, inclusive); a `mutation` changes one residue, and the original residue was checked. No sequence was typed by hand.
